changesets.summary: Combo box filters as you type and commits on enter
changesets.details: An uncontrolled combo box now filters its options as you type: the input text has a single source of truth, controlled or uncontrolled. The arrow keys move focus through the visible options and enter (or a click) selects the focused option and moves its label into the input. `ListBox` gains an optional `focused_key` prop so an owner such as the combo box input can drive option focus. `ComboBox` also gains a `class` prop, added after the built-in `leptos-aria-combo-box` class on a new root element.

review_request.title: fix(combo_box): filter uncontrolled input and commit focused option
fix(combo_box): filter uncontrolled input and commit focused option

changesets.summary: Every component takes a class prop
changesets.details: Headless components now accept `class` directly (`<AccordionTrigger class="data-[state=open]:font-bold">`) instead of requiring Leptos' `attr:class`. The class is a reactive `Signal<String>`, so strings and closures both work, and it is appended after the built-in `leptos-aria-*` class. Also fixes Pagination's next button, which never fired because an unbraced `>=` in its `disabled` attribute ended the tag early.

review_request.title: feat: a class prop on every headless component
feat: a class prop on every headless component

changesets.summary: Reactive progress, pagination, slider, and avatar fixes
changesets.details: Avatar now shows its image once it loads: the image stays hidden in the tree until its load event fires, and a failed load keeps the fallback. ProgressBar and Meter recompute aria-valuenow, aria-valuetext, and the fill width whenever the value or indeterminate state changes, and ProgressBar renders the label its aria-labelledby points at. Pagination moves aria-current and data-current with the page and re-renders its buttons when the count changes. A controlled Slider value now moves the native range input. TextField renders its label only when one is given, takes id and aria_label props, and keeps a controlled value in the input after typing; Radio no longer puts its input's id on the label too. Tabs skip disabled tabs with the arrow keys, Home, End, and clicks, and keep the first enabled tab focusable while nothing is selected.

review_request.title: fix: reactive progress, pagination, slider, and avatar state
fix: reactive progress, pagination, slider, and avatar state

changesets.summary: List box options honour their disabled state
changesets.details: A ListBoxOption with is_disabled set can no longer be selected by a click or by Enter or Space, and arrow keys, Home, End, and type-ahead skip it. The flag is read when it is needed, so an option disabled after it gained focus is ignored too. ListBoxContext gains register_option, which records an option's key with its disabled flag, and is_key_disabled; register_key still registers an enabled option. Type-ahead without a focused option now checks the first option first. Menu relies on the list box for disabled items instead of guarding them itself.

review_request.title: fix(list_box): skip and refuse disabled options
fix(list_box): unregister options when they unmount

changesets.summary: List box options unregister when they unmount
changesets.details: A ListBoxOption now removes its key from the list box when it unmounts, so a list box whose options re-render, such as a filtering ComboBox, no longer piles up duplicate and stale keys. Keyboard navigation follows the options that are mounted, and aria-activedescendant clears when the focused option goes away. Each option gets a document-unique id when it registers, which stays the same while it is mounted, so ids no longer shift or collide as options come and go. ListBoxContext gains options, a map from key to ListBoxOptionEntry holding the option's id and disabled flag. A registration through register_option or register_key now lasts until the current reactive owner is cleaned up.

review_request.title: fix(list_box): unregister options when they unmount
fix(list_box): unregister options when they unmount

changesets.details: Every crate that depends on `leptos` now exposes a `nightly` cargo feature that forwards to `leptos`'s own `nightly` feature, unlocking nightly-only signal and renderer optimizations (signals callable as functions, faster view codegen). The facade's feature enables it across all member crates at once: `leptos_aria = { version = "0.1", features = ["nightly"] }`. The feature is additive and a no-op on stable toolchains, and CI now lints the workspace with it enabled. The registry components also wrap their derived class closures in `Signal::derive` explicitly, so the components you copy with the CLI compile unchanged on nightly toolchains.

review_request.title: feat: opt-in nightly feature for leptos optimizations

changesets.summary: One-time password field labels its group
changesets.details: `OneTimePasswordField` now renders its label before the cells, as a `span` that names the `role="group"` through `aria-labelledby`. Before, it rendered a `<label for>` after the group, pointing at an id no element had. Attributes spread onto the field (`attr:data-slot`, …) now reach only the group, not the label. `use_labels` also stops emitting an empty `aria-labelledby=""` on unlabelled fields: text fields without a visible label, and progress bars.

review_request.title: fix(text_field): label the one-time password group and render it first
fix(text_field): label the one-time password group and render it first

changesets.summary: Select box and menus manage their own popups
changesets.details: SelectBox shows its chosen option on the trigger, hides its list until opened, and closes on a choice, escape, or a press outside, moving focus into the list and back. It takes value, default_value, on_change, and placeholder, plus trigger_class, popup_class, option_class, an indicator for each option, and trigger children. Its class now sits on a new root element. Menu runs the chosen item, by click or with Enter or Space on the highlighted one, through on_action on the menu and on each MenuItem, then closes, and skips disabled items. MenuTrigger takes an is_open signal, shares it with the Menu inside, and closes on an outside press. ListBox sets aria-activedescendant to the highlighted option and drops aria-labelledby when it has no label. The overlay crate adds use_popup_focus, which moves focus into a popup on open and back to its trigger on close.

review_request.title: feat: select box and menus manage their own popups
feat: select box and menus manage their own popups

changesets.summary: Selection checks no longer clone whole collections
changesets.details: List box, tags, tree, tabs, toggle groups, checkbox groups, combo box, and selection state now borrow their reactive sets instead of cloning them per item and per keypress, removing quadratic work on selection changes. Every crate also gains a real description, a logo'd readme for crates.io, and the leptos_aria logo and favicon on docs.rs.

review_request.title: feat: logo, generated website, and selection performance pass
feat: logo, generated website, and selection performance pass

changesets.details: `leptos-aria init` writes `leptos-aria.json`, shadcn's theme CSS variables, and a `cn` helper backed by `tw_merge`. `leptos-aria add <name>` copies Tailwind-styled components into `src/components/ui`, declares their modules, runs `cargo add`, and writes their CSS. `list`, `view`, and `diff` read the registry, and `build` turns any `registry.json` into a hostable registry in shadcn's registry-item schema, with namespaced registries supported. The website gains a component index, a page per component, and a CLI guide.

changesets.summary: Text fields render their label first
changesets.details: `TextField` and `TextArea` now render their `<label>` before the field, and attributes spread onto them (`attr:data-slot`, `attr:autocomplete`, …) reach only the `<input>` or `<textarea>`, matching upstream `useTextField`. Previously the label came after the field and received every spread attribute too, so the registry's `Input` and `Textarea` showed their label below the field. `TextField` also no longer renders an empty `<label>` when it has no label.

changesets.summary: Toggle groups gain multiple mode and a value
changesets.details: ToggleGroup's mode prop now takes the public ToggleGroupMode (Single or Multiple), so multiple selection is reachable. The group also takes a controlled value with an on_change callback that receives every pressed value.
